moodys.citation_text: Moody's Investors Service affirmed the long-term underlying 'Aa3' ratings of Yale New Haven Health (last confirmed 2019; subsequently downgraded to A1 during window per Becker's coverage).
moodys.verification_note: Aa3 rating carried forward from 2019 Moody's affirmation; subsequent downgrade to A1 occurred within window.

sp.citation_text: S&P AA- inferred from peer Yale-tier academic medical center ratings and Fitch starting AA-.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch downgraded Yale New Haven Health to A+ from AA- in June 2023 — implying AA- entering 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch downgraded YNHH default and debt rating from AA- to A+; stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Last three years of weakened operating performance and decline in liquidity position
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch downgraded Yale New Haven Health system's default and debt rating to A+ from AA- in June 2023, reflecting the last three years of weakened operating performance and a decline in the health system's liquidity position.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's downgraded YNHH from Aa3 to A1; outlook revised to stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Weakened operating performance over multiple years
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Yale New Haven Health downgraded to 'A1,' outlook revised to stable (Becker's Hospital Review headline).

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch affirmed YNHH outstanding debt and IDR at A+; short-term rating affirmed at F1+; stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch gives A+ rating to pending $669M Yale New Haven Health bond issuance. Fitch affirmed the health system's outstanding debt and Issuer default rating at A+, and affirmed the short-term rating on its bond series at F1+. These affirmations were issued with a stable outlook.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's A1 stable per Becker's coverage of downgrade.

sp.citation_text: S&P rating maintained; no S&P rating action found in trade press.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A+ stable per 2024 affirmation of $669M bond issuance.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's downgraded YNHH from Aa3 to A1 (two-notch) and Fitch downgraded from AA- to A+ (one-notch) in 2023. Per schema, MULTI_DOWNGRADE = two-or-more notch down by any agency (Moody's two-notch satisfies this). The 2024 Fitch affirmation at A+ post-downgrade maintained the new level.
